Z time stop · T lock target (hold T or Y to release) · Hold fire and scroll to zoom · R ice · Tab skills · V track call · N music · M mute · ] skip villain

AEGIS

Defender of the city. Aliens are invading. Protect the citizens and survive each wave. Every fifth wave a villain arrives.

WASD move and fly · Mouse look · Space jump, then Space again to fly
Hold Space rise · C descend · Shift super speed · F toggle flight
Hold left mouse: laser eyes · Right mouse: punch · E grab and throw a car · Q ground slam
Rescue stranded or falling citizens: touch them, then carry them to the green safe zone
T lock onto an enemy (hold T or Y to release) · While firing, your hero hides and the scroll wheel zooms
Dispatch tells you where rescues are (V cycles the tracked call) · Z time stop · Tab skill tree between waves · C air dash (Mobility tier 3) · N music · R ice breath · Fly at super speed through enemies for a sonic ram · Grab glowing orbs for power-ups
Chain kills for combos · Finish each wave goal for bonus points · Guardians block frontal lasers: hit them from behind, punch or slam · M mutes voices
Between waves press 1 to 5 to spend skill points
